paper.abstract_en: Grey-body factors describe the frequency-dependent transmission of fields through the effective potential generated by a black hole or another compact object. They convert the idealized thermal spectrum of Hawking radiation into the spectrum measured by an observer, determine absorption and scattering cross sections, and provide real-frequency observables complementary to quasinormal modes. In this review, we present a unified account of grey-body factors in black-hole physics and related systems. We formulate the scattering problem for asymptotically flat, de Sitter, and anti-de Sitter spacetimes, and discuss the connections between transmission coefficients, absorption cross sections, Hawking radiation, and ringdown. We also review methods for their computation and survey recent developments, including the correspondence between grey-body factors and quasinormal modes, their stability under deformations of the effective potential, wormhole transmission and superradiance, and their behavior in modified theories of gravity. Finally, we discuss the appearance of grey-body factors in gauge/gravity duality, where absorption probabilities in the bulk are related to correlation functions and transport coefficients in the boundary theory.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文系统综述黑洞物理中的灰体因子，涵盖渐近平直、德西特与反德西特时空的散射问题，并将其与霍金辐射、吸收截面、准正模、虫洞透射、超辐射及规范/引力对偶联系起来，理论深度与覆盖面较好，适合点击进一步阅读。
decision.abstract_zh: 灰体因子描述场通过由黑洞或其他致密天体产生的有效势时的频率相关透射。它们将理想化的霍金辐射热谱转换为观测者测量到的谱，决定吸收截面与散射截面，并提供与准正模互补的实频可观测量。在这篇综述中，我们给出黑洞物理及相关系统中灰体因子的统一论述。我们表述了渐近平直、德西特和反德西特时空中的散射问题，并讨论了透射系数、吸收截面、霍金辐射与铃宕（ringdown）之间的联系。我们还回顾了计算它们的方法，并综述了近期进展，包括灰体因子与准正模之间的对应关系、它们在有效势形变下的稳定性、虫洞透射与超辐射，以及它们在修改引力理论中的行为。最后，我们讨论了灰体因子在规范/引力对偶中的出现，其中体（bulk）内的吸收概率与边界理论中的关联函数和输运系数相关。
